note: Iraq upscale areas for the villa 1.45M campaign (ad set 52513851038679, built 2026-11-22, draft). No neighbourhood boundaries were available (geoBoundaries IRQ has districts only; OSM is blocked), so the centres come from published coordinates (Wikipedia mirrors, bamwor, latlong.net via web search) and each circle was checked only against geoBoundaries IRQ ADM2 districts: the Baghdad circles stay on their own bank of the Tigris (Karkh / Risafa 98-100%), Erbil 100%. Not verified at neighbourhood level; ask someone who knows Baghdad and Erbil before widening them. Dream City, Empire World and Italian Village (Erbil) were left out: no reliable coordinates found.
